pkg.title: Package management
pkg.hint: Install or remove packages (up to %d). The agent runs a dry run first; changes are applied after you review and confirm them. The agent needs allow_package_management: true.
pkg.protectedHint: Protected packages such as the kernel, boot, SSH, the package manager and the Sentrix agent cannot be removed; operations that would remove them as dependencies are refused too.
